description: This file provides an extensive overview and specification documentation for the 'CompositeInput' HAL interface related to analog composite video inputs. It details interface definitions, operational sequences, capabilities, state machines, event handling, discovery patterns, telemetry, and customization options pertinent to this specific HAL implementation.

classes.name: VideoResolution
classes.description: Parcelable object encapsulating video resolution details, including standard, format, width, height, and interlacing information.

classes.name: PortCapabilities
classes.description: Defines the capabilities of a port, including supported properties and metrics support flag.

classes.name: Port
classes.description: Represents metadata and interface for a specific composite input port, including retrieving capabilities, properties, and controlling activation.

classes.name: PortMetrics
classes.description: Telemetry data including lock time, drops, uptime, and reset timestamp for a port.

classes.name: PropertyKVPair
classes.description: Key-value pair structure for batch property retrieval. Value is a union of supported types.

methods.name: getPlatformCapabilities
methods.description: Retrieves platform-wide feature flags and capabilities such as supported ports and features.

methods.name: getPortIds
methods.description: Returns a list of available composite input port IDs.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Retrieves the interface handle for a specific port by ID.

methods.name: getCapabilities
methods.description: Returns the capabilities of a specific port, including supported properties and metrics support.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific property key from a port.

methods.name: getPropertyMulti
methods.description: Batch retrieves multiple property values by their keys.

methods.name: getMetrics
methods.description: Returns current telemetry metrics if supported.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Activates or deactivates the port for video presentation; only one port can be active at a time.

methods.name: registerEventListener
methods.description: Registers an event callback listener for connection, signal, or video mode changes.

methods.name: unregisterEventListener
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered event callback listener.

methods.name: resetMetrics
methods.description: Resets telemetry metrics counters, if supported.
